mapper.sql: SELECT cert_id, org_id, project_id, seal_id, cert_type, subject_dn, issuer_dn, serial_no, fingerprint_sha256, not_before, not_after, status, cert_pem, chain_pem, key_ref, issued_at, revoked_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM sign_cert
mapper.select: WHERE seal_id = #{sealId} AND status = '0' ORDER BY issued_at DESC, cert_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sign_cert ( org_id, project_id, seal_id, cert_type, subject_dn, issuer_dn, serial_no, fingerprint_sha256, not_before, not_after, status, cert_pem, chain_pem, key_ref, issued_at, revoked_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{orgId}, #{projectId}, #{sealId}, #{certType}, #{subjectDn}, #{issuerDn}, #{serialNo}, #{fingerprintSha256}, #{notBefore}, #{notAfter}, #{status}, #{certPem}, #{chainPem}, #{keyRef}, #{issuedAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sign_cert SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE cert_id = #{certId}
